user.title: ING Stocks Plus
user.description: Add an ISIN to track price and optional key figures. Set quantity > 0 for position value. P/E comes from ING when available (Yahoo chart has no P/E).

data.name: Name (optional)
data.yahoo_fallback: Yahoo Finance fallback for dividend (not P/E)
data.market_hours_polling: Slower polling outside Xetra/US market hours

error.invalid_isin: Invalid ISIN format (expected 12 characters, e.g. IE00B3RBWM25).
error.isin_not_found: ISIN not found in the ING instrument API.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the ING instrument API. Try again later.

init.title: Options
init.description: Set quantity > 0 to populate the position value sensor. Yahoo fills missing dividends when ING has no data. Market-hours mode uses a longer interval when Xetra and US markets are closed.

data.name: Name (optional)
data.yahoo_fallback: Yahoo Finance fallback for dividend (not P/E)
data.market_hours_polling: Slower polling outside Xetra/US market hours
